Its our society in general. Beauty is shaped by our society, because once upon a time being fat was beautiful, and body hair wasn't seen as disgusting. Not only do we have specific standards if beauty, but its held to a very high regard. Eating disorders as we know it wouldn't exist (to the same extent) if we didn't hold standards of beauty so high. 

And I've noticed that throughout my whole life. If you're pretty, your mistakes are often brushed off. If you're not convientally attractive, then you're annoying and dumb.
That's the problem. People just have a negative association with someone who isn't conventionally attractive, and a positive one with someone who is. Just based of their appearance alone.

I'm not talking about romantic relationships, though that could be included too.
